title: Q-SCOUT-nofeed-sources: scout sources that publish no Atom/RSS feed
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/scout.json::"kind": "page"
**Status:** closed

foundation/scout.py (SCOUT-1, #292) reads Atom/RSS only. Competitors and best-practice bodies with no feed are unwatched: Copilot coding-agent docs, Cursor docs, Devin docs, Factory, OWASP LLM Top 10, Anthropic building-effective-agents. Add a `page` source kind: fetch, strip markup, hash lines, score only lines new since the last pass with the existing scorer, same weights and adoption feedback. Test with recorded pages. Source: closed PR #293 (page-diff prototype, history kept there).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 214.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
